# FernPay

Payments for marketplaces, without the paperwork

FernPay handles split payouts, KYC and refunds for marketplaces, so you can pay sellers in 40 countries from one API.

## Features

### Split payouts

Pay many sellers from one charge, automatically.

### KYC built in

Onboard sellers with identity checks that pass audits.

### 40 countries

Local payout rails where your sellers are.

## Who it is for

Marketplace founders.

## Pricing

Starts free. Team plans from $29 per month.
